findings.text: 反复在需求不清时改代码、收尾缺测试证据的开发者，可在非关键任务中把规格和测试轨迹带回交付复核，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
bundle装grill/guard两行，折叠会话工具事件、规格与测试渲染结果，按强度提醒/ask/deny，另跑可选checker/reviewer并写报告，见 [Q02](#research-q02)至 [Q04](#research-q04)。
核两行装配，grill/spec/report/verify关键链、guard配置/前置/关闭提示/命令，域证据和报告、四阶段gate执行/失败与reviewer真实启动；未全审所有清单规则/CI出口/宿主执行器或运行。
原生bundle两行激活，根为共享导出；具体宿主兼容需另验。

#### 依赖

| 条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 兼容DSH/Node与两行bundle | 必需 | 插件/命令/工具 | 根导出不是激活两行 |
| 实际工具/测试命令/结果格式 | 证据条件 | 红绿和改动归因 | 名单外不代表已覆盖 |
| 宿主fs和工作区 | 写文件条件 | spec/report/CI JSON | false/静默跳写要核 |
| workflowEngine/子Agent/模型 | 验证评审条件 | checker/reviewer | null/skip/unavailable |
| 新版只读reviewer preset | startActivation宿主 | 评审权限 | 未配则不运行 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 资源/现金 | 人工时间 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 宿主/Node/fs | 模式/路径/preset匹配 | 未测耗时 |
| 持续 | 测试、checker/review模型 | 规格维护/复核误报 | 六维fanout非总token预算 |
| 失败 | 重跑可增加请求 | 分false/skip/取消 | 不把文件缺失当未执行 |
| 退出 | 会话/报告留存 | 核关闭恢复与活任务 | 不自动清理业务文件 |
试用：非关键小改动保持默认remind，人工核spec与真实测试，再读gate四阶段。skip或written:false需回原证据补核，不把deliverable当发布许可；误挡/误报时off并回手工清单和CI，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

#### 效果

| 效果 | 当前支持 | 未确认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 需求记录 | 六维与成功调用折叠 | 用户确已达成共识 |
| 红绿纪律 | 结果分类/前置策略 | 全写路径/断言覆盖 |
| 评审 | 真实子Agent与未知结果 | 独立正确性 |
| 交付报告 | 分阶段/可写JSON | 净返工减少与费用 |
会话日志折叠与成功spec配对、未知评审及局部写失败分开有价值；默认强度/名单/二元verdict语义需显式解释，见 [Q02](#research-q02)至 [Q04](#research-q04)。
将需求规格、测试轨迹、评审和阶段裁决放同一会话，真实支持工作流checker和缺服务降级；效果与全部工具覆盖未验，见 [Q01](#research-q01)至 [Q04](#research-q04)。
默认remind不会挡写；测试依工具/命令/结果文本，gate的deliverable允许warn/skip，评审不可用不等于已证质量，见 [Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。
未验证方向是突出证据完备三态和报告调用的模型/写盘副作用，比较未知评审/写失败时的误判与阅读成本，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

recommendation.reason: 常因需求不清或测试证据遗漏而返工的开发者，可先在非关键小改动中使用默认提醒与报告。它把规格、测试轨迹和评审状态集中，但跳过评审时仍可能显示可交付，必须检查阶段细项。出现误挡、误报或状态难解释时，应关闭纪律并回到人工清单和原 CI。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)两行围绕明确开发交接任务超25%，无实际频率/返工对照未达75%，取50%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)规格成功配对、真实fs/workflow及[Q04](#research-q04)未知分支足支撑非关键提醒试用，超25%碎片；未运行宿主/效果不达75%，取源码上限50%。

See [Reading the status line](#reading-the-status-line). |\n\n### Reading the status line\n\nThe `doublecheck` session projection is a plain **string**, and it is deliberately one line — the whole point is that a client can show it without cutting anything off. A chat bridge's `/status`, a status bar, or any custom consumer renders it as it is:\n\n```text\ngate:rework r2 | stage:green | test:green edits:12 spec:yes review:yes | goal:ship parser fix\n```\n\n| Segment | Reads as |\n|---|---|\n| `gate: r` | The latest delivery-gate verdict — `none` before any run, `deliverable`, or `rework` — and its red-light count `r`. |\n| `stage:` | The discipline stage reached on durable evidence: `grill`, `design`, `red`, `green`, `review`, `verify`. |\n| `test:` | The latest test-run color: `none`, `red`, `green`. |\n| `edits:` | Implementation edits folded from the session log (test-file writes are not counted). |\n| `spec:yes` / `spec:no` | Whether a committed `doublecheck_spec` exists. |\n| `review:yes` / `review:no` | Whether an adversary review record exists. |\n| `goal:` | The committed spec goal, clipped. Present only when `spec:yes`. |\n\nThe line is bounded **by construction**, so no renderer truncates it:\n\n- Hard budget: **120 characters**. A renderer that keeps values up to 120 characters — the WeChat bridge's generic projection renderer is one — shows the entire line. The old object-shaped payload was 131 characters when *empty*, which is why the verdict and the red count used to be cut off.\n- The first three segments are **lossless**. Counts above `9999` red lights or `99999` edits print as `9999+` / `99999+` instead of growing without bound; a non-finite or negative count prints as `0`.\n- `goal:` is the one lossy segment. It is flattened to a single line (newlines and control characters become spaces, `|` becomes `/`) and clipped to the budget that is left, at most 40 characters, ending in `…` when it was clipped. The complete goal is in `/doublecheck status` and the delivery report.\n- This is a glance, not the record: `/gate status` and `/doublecheck status` render the full state.\n\nThe projection's `stateVersion` is **3**. Bumping it discards a persisted projection-cache row written by an older version and refolds the key from the session log, so an upgraded session recomputes the line instead of showing a stale one. The persisted fold state itself is unchanged, and a pre-upgrade session never fails to load.\n\n## Gate phases\n\nThe delivery gate aggregates the session's durable evidence into a configurable four-phase checklist and settles one **deliverable / rework required** decision. Every phase folds the session log alone (replay IS the state), so a run re-derives identically after resume or fork.\n\n| Phase | Checks | Evidence source | Model cost |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Requirements interrogation | Key-question checklist confirmed item by item (six spec-dimension questions by default) | Committed `doublecheck_spec` + `ask_user_question` calls | none |\n| Test evidence | Latest run color, failing runs after green, optional coverage threshold, optional dsh-eval report | Shell test runs in the session log (`[exit code: N]`, coverage percentages); the dsh-eval report file when `gate.tests.evalReports.enabled` | none |\n| Implementation consistency | Diff ↔ requirement mapping: every edit must serve a spec dimension | Local forked reviewer (structured findings, read-only tools) | one subagent |\n| Review conclusion | The delivery verdict; `engine: auto` consumes dsh-auto-review's durable verdict records when present, else the local reviewer | `autoReview/verdict` / `autoReview/rejection` events, or the local forked reviewer | one subagent (local) |\n\nRed lights are failed checks (a missing spec, a failing latest run, coverage below minimum, an unmapped edit, blocker/major findings) — each carries a rework suggestion. Warnings and skips never flip the decision. The gate integrates [dsh-auto-review](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-auto-review) as a weak dependency: `review.engine: auto` folds its verdict records when present and degrades to the local reviewer otherwise; `gate.tests.evalReports.enabled` folds its eval engine's dsh-eval report (prompt-regression / stress / fairness suites) into the test evidence and skips honestly when no report exists.
